description: Screen England & Wales postcode districts. Filters (all optional): median sold price range over 12 months, live asking rent range a month, minimum active sale listings, price-cut share range (from the week of 2026-11-02), and region (including "Wales"). Sort by price, rent, listings or price_cut. Returns the matching districts with their figures and links. Use for questions like "districts in the North West with a median under £200k and asking rent over £900". Districts with fewer than 30 sales have no median; fewer than 20 rent listings no asking rent. Asking rents and prices are not agreed or sold prices.

max_asking_rent_pcm.description: Maximum median asking rent a month in GBP (optional)

max_median_price_gbp.description: Maximum 12m median sold price in GBP (optional)

max_price_cut_pct.description: Maximum share of sale listings that were price-reduced, in percent (optional)

min_asking_rent_pcm.description: Minimum median asking rent a month in GBP (optional)

min_median_price_gbp.description: Minimum 12m median sold price in GBP (optional)

min_price_cut_pct.description: Minimum share of sale listings that were price-reduced, in percent (optional)

order.description: asc or desc (default: asc for price and rent, desc for listings and price_cut)

region.description: One region name: North East, North West, Yorkshire and The Humber, East Midlands, West Midlands, East of England, London, South East, South West, Wales (optional)

name: screen_areas
title: Screen districts by price, rent, listings and region
